edges.notes: FUSE is a Linux kernel facility for delegating filesystem operations to userspace per kernel documentation.
FUSE mounts are scoped by mount namespaces like other filesystems on Linux.
OverlayFS is an in-kernel stacked filesystem; FUSE delegates to userspace — different mechanisms for different use cases.
OCI images define layer manifests and blobs; FUSE is unrelated to image format law though mounts may appear in roots.
Docker volume and storage plugins on Linux may involve FUSE-based drivers where configured.
Kubernetes CSI drivers on Linux may use FUSE-based implementations where supported and permitted on nodes.
containerd snapshotters and mount setup can interact with FUSE mounts on Linux in advanced storage setups.
